# BDD-X

Driving videos with textual descriptions and explanations of human driver actions.

## Example input and output

This is a source-grounded illustration of the task shape, not a copied or verified dataset row.

**Input:** A road video and the interval of a human driving action.

**Output / label:** A textual action description and the observer-attributed reason.

[Open the author-provided sample or demo](https://github.com/JinkyuKimUCB/BDD-X-dataset)

**Example evidence:** [official](https://github.com/JinkyuKimUCB/BDD-X-dataset)

## Intention in this dataset

Observer-authored explanations attribute reasons to observed human driver behavior. They provide motive judgments rather than driver self-reports or prospective intentions.

**Relevance:** `explicit` · **Origin:** `real` · **Year:** 2018

**Domains:** driver_behavior, autonomous_driving  
**Intention types:** driving_maneuver  
**Tasks:** intention_reasoning  
**Modalities:** rgb, text, vehicle_telemetry, trajectory  
**Formats:** video, text, time_series, structured_annotation
